exposure: Automated transperineal ultrasound (TPU) assessment of fetal head station (FHS)
Digital vaginal examination (DVE) assessment of FHS
outcome: Reliability of fetal head station (FHS) assessment
Accuracy of fetal head station (FHS) assessment
cohort: 27 pregnant women in the second stage of labor, with fetuses in cephalic presentation.
finding: The proposed automatic algorithm for fetal head station assessment using transperineal ultrasound showed high accuracy and strong correlation with expert sonographer assessment, performing better than digital vaginal examination.
cross-section timing: During the second stage of labor
